title: Every pool eval row checks the fact that answers it, and every model alias cites the kb
goal: Every eval row of the question pool (kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv) and its variants checks a fact line that answers its question: none is checked against a line about something else (the Autopilot motherboard rows) or holds only an article path (the five rows left path-only); and bench_core.ALIAS's opus row cites the kb line that states which model the opus alias names, as the haiku and sonnet rows do.
